# SlainteTech AI Security Labs (Slainte-Engine Platform)

> Sovereign Clinical AI, Cybersecurity Red-Teaming & HL7 FHIR R4 Interoperability Platform bound by Deterministic FastMCP Guardrails.

## Core Architecture
- **SlainteDash (:8000)**: Multi-vertical HTMX clinical workstation, SMART-on-FHIR v2 App Launch, OIDC PKCE SSO, Granular Clinical RBAC & Break-the-Glass.
- **SlainteFHIR (:8082)**: Sovereign HL7 FHIR R4 Micro-EHR (SQLite WAL + PostgreSQL 16 Row-Level Security schema).
- **SlainteScan (:8081)**: Deterministic Python FastMCP server executing Manchester Triage (Cat 1-5), RCP NEWS2 (0-20), SNOMED/LOINC/UCUM validation, and 3-Tier SlainteRx-Guard pharmacology checks.
- **11 Autonomous Agents**:
  - 01 SlainteShield-BOLA (OWASP API1:2023 Red-Team Verifier)
  - 02 SlainteShield-FHIR (FHIR R4 & Irish GMS OID Conformance + OASIS SARIF v2.1.0)
  - 03 SlainteShield-CVE (Supply-Chain Pins, SRI sha384 & CSP Security Auditor)
  - 04 SlainteGov-GDPR (GDPR Art. 9 PII De-Identification & BAA Gate)
  - 05 SlainteGov-Audit (Immutable SQLite Kernel Triggers, SHA-256 Provenance & SIEM Webhooks)
  - 06 SlainteEngine-Ingest (Native HL7v2 Pipe-Hat + Multimodal PDF/CSV/OCR Harmonizer)
  - 07 SlainteScribe-Brief (Cited [ResourceType/id] Clinical Handover Summariser)
  - 08 SlainteRx-Guard (3-Tier Allergy + ISMP High-Alert DDI + Lab eGFR Renal Gate)
  - 09 SlainteDx-Triage (Deterministic MTS Cat 1-5 & 24h NEWS2 Trajectory Engine)
  - 10 SlainteScribe-Voice (Ambient Clinical Voice Scribe & Pre-Screened FHIR Order Drafter)
  - 11 SlainteRev-Coding (Autonomous HIPE / ICD-10-AM / SNOMED Comorbidity & DRG Revenue Auditor)
